outcome: epileptic seizure control during pregnancy (all types)
cohort: The study participants were 74 pregnancies of women with surgically treated focal epilepsy and 1013 pregnancies of women with medically treated focal epilepsy, all drawn from the Australian Register of Antiepileptic Drugs in Pregnancy.
finding: Seizures of all types and convulsive seizures were less well controlled during pregnancy in women with previously surgically treated epilepsy compared to those with only medically treated epilepsy.
